title: Orange vs Blue Stickman: SUPERHUMAN HAND-TO-HAND COMBAT! (Full Action Movie)
description:
Best friend turned lethal weapon. When a covert syndicate locks the Winter Override Protocol and a hydraulic titanium arm onto Blue Stickman (Asset Zero), Orange Stickman is ambushed on a rain-drenched highway overpass with nothing but his bare hands and pure martial arts instinct.

Across 10 nonstop minutes of Hollywood hand-to-hand combat — Krav Maga blade disarms, Heavyweight Boxing vs Ip Man Wing Chun chain punches, Jackie Chan improvised folding-chair & ladder combat, Kyokushin Karate, Judo throws, and an exhausting 80th-floor lightning-storm climax — only brotherhood can shatter the mask.
